original: WPRPLACE is a small island in the Archipelago Sea in the Baltic Sea and belongs to Finland's Pargas municipality. It is the southernmost year-round inhabited island in Finland. WPRPLACE has an area of 0.81 square kilometres and the population was c. 40 .
